definition.plain: ANNA is a vertical agent (a sellable product) instantiated by the sealed Entity/Substrate birth capability. ANNA = the persistent personality; the dental clinic role = a skill. The MVP starts as a THIN VERTICAL SLICE: one ANNA, one booking skill, one channel (Telegram), per-client memory — proving birth and product together at minimal token cost. Built only through the same lawful self-construction chain, with an honest readiness ledger.
definition.role: bridge from the sealed Entity/Substrate to a real revenue product

direction_name: ANNA MVP vertical agent, born by the sealed Entity/Substrate birth capability

first_frontier_target.goal: Birth exactly ONE ANNA instance from the sealed entity substrate with a single booking skill over Telegram + per-client memory. Proves BOTH the birth capability and a sellable product slice together, at minimal token cost.
in_scope: thin entity instantiation engine (reads substrate surfaces -> 1 live ANNA object)
ANNA vertical-agent identity (dental) bound to the sealed product_binding surface
single skill: booking intent -> real appointment record (local store first)
per-client memory (profile + history) reused from wavecore-bot/anna
token budget declared and metered for the slice

token_economy.principle: every frontier declares an estimated token budget; work is metered; the evolutionary aim is each repeat of a process costs less than the last

truth_boundary: ANNA MVP direction build only. Writes a declarative direction document (lawful sub-chain, honest readiness ledger, thin-vertical-slice frontier, token gates, roadmap). Births no entity, instantiates no ANNA, runs nothing, spawns no agent, uses no network/daemon/background/scheduler, claims no AGI/L3, approves no canon, and makes no revenue claim. ANNA birth stays gated behind its own lawful chain.
